description: Fix SRS review persistence: seeded cards carry an FSRS-invalid memory state that the rating route swallowed as HTTP 200, and the activity log rejected the flashcard targetId, so reviews, activity, and XP never persisted. Browser QA 2026-09-17, P0.
deviation_notes: Two root causes: (1) rating route returned HTTP 200 on FSRSValidationError for stability-0 seeded cards — now normalizes uninitialized memory to fresh-card init, clamps sub-floor difficulty, and returns real statuses; (2) resolveActivityTarget ignored explicit top-level targetId so every flashcard XP post got 400 — now accepted. Review H1: targetId acceptance widens tech-debt F-D5 fake-target XP farming; registry row amended, expedite the server-side target verification fix. Red test shipped inside the fix commit rather than a red-only commit. Implemented 2026-09-18 (commit 191b546). Owner manual verification pending.
